title: Consume independent gcode_core through pinned Git dependency
execution_instructions: Read AGENTS.md and required contracts. Replace apps/flutter_forge/pubspec.yaml gcode_core path dependency with git url https://github.com/lizy-coding/gcode_core.git and ref 7a5228126d6e43b0cb9175b035cd2e1701950779.
Remove packages/gcode_core from root workspace and remove its tracked files: user already migrated them to independent repository. Do not reintroduce them.

Update tool/generate_agent_indexes.js and tool/validate_agent_docs.js to remove gcode_core from workspace package ownership, describe pinned external git dependency, and regenerate documents. Update tool/test_all.sh to no longer run tests in deleted packages/gcode_core; retain app gcode consumer tests and all other test suites.
Run flutter pub get, documentation generator, flutter analyze, bash tool/test_all.sh, bash tool/quality_gate.sh. Preserve public imports and app functionality. No push, no release, no version change.
acceptance: git dependency resolves at exact upstream revision
